item.description: Watch the latest Accuweather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

item.title: Miramonte teen killer to spend six years in custody as teacher says, 'I really like the kid'
item.description: After a gruesome scene in the mountains two years ago, the Miramonte teen who admitted to killing his parents and injuring his sister learned he will spend six years in custody.

item.title: Porterville mother accepts plea deal after leaving son in hot car during cosmetic procedure
item.description: A Porterville mother has accepted a plea deal in the death of her son, who was left in a hot car for hours in Bakersfield last year.

item.title: Fresno State's first football schedule in Pac-12 revealed, features unique 'flex game'
item.description: While living up to its moniker, "after dark," the Pac-12 unveiled Fresno State's first football schedule in the revived conference on Wednesday night.

item.title: Rain doesn't stop day 2 of the World Ag Expo in Tulare County
item.description: The rainy weather did not stop thousands of people from attending what was the busiest day of the World Ag Expo in Tulare County.

item.title: Instagram chief says he does not believe people can get clinically addicted to social media
item.description: Adam Mosseri, the head of Meta's Instagram, testified Wednesday during a landmark social media trial that he disagrees with the idea that people can be clinically addicted to social media platforms.

item.title: Fresno Unified employees voice budget cut concerns at board meeting
item.description: As the Fresno Unified School District navigates a budget deficit, classified employees are voicing their concerns about possible layoffs to their essential workforce.

item.title: Bud Cort, best known for role in 'Harold and Maude,' dies at 77
item.description: Actor Bud Cort, best known for his role in the 1971 film "Harold and Maude," has died. He was 77.

item.title: Multiple suspects wanted in smash-and-grab robbery at Clovis Kay Jewelers, police say
item.description: An investigation is underway after multiple masked suspects robbed the Kay Jewelers on Herndon Avenue in Clovis Wednesday night.

item.title: Phone scams increase amid Nancy Guthrie disappearance case
item.description: Phone scams have been on law enforcement's radar for decades, but after the Nancy Guthrie abduction, agencies nationwide report a rise in scams that create fear and panic in specific age groups and demographics.
